The Art — What the Game Looks Like
🐉
Game Logo
Gold letters spelling DRAGONCRAFT with a real dragon curled around the G. Made with an AI image tool.
✓ Done
🏘️
Minimap Village
A beautiful medieval village seen from above — trading houses, a glowing wizard tower, and a dragon training school.
✓ Done
🗺️
World Map
A parchment map with mountains, forests, plains, a beach, and the sea. Minimap village sits near the river.
✓ Done
✨
Starting the Game
🌟
Title Screen
The logo glows in on a black screen. After 2 seconds the "Enter Game" button appears. If you have a saved game, "Continue" shows up too!
✓ Done
🌍
World Map Loads
Click Enter Game and the screen smoothly fades into the world map. You can see your village waiting for you.
✓ Done
🏰
Enter Your Village
Click Minimap on the map and zoom straight into the village. A "Back to Map" button lets you leave whenever you want.
✓ Done
🏡
Life in Minimap Village
🍖
Resources
Food, Gold, and Wood tick up by themselves every few seconds. Watch the numbers grow in the corner of the screen!
✓ Done
🌸
Four Seasons
Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter each last 15 real minutes. Harvest bonuses arrive in Autumn — but Winter slows everything down!
✓ Done
📅
Game Days
Every 2 real minutes is one whole day in the game. Houses need 10 days before they're ready for new villagers.
✓ Done
🏠
Clickable Houses
Click any of the 5 houses to open a menu. You can welcome a new villager for 50 food — but only if it's not Winter!
✓ Done
👥
Real Villagers
Five real people live in Minimap — Aldric, Brenna, Caelan, Dwyn, and Eira. Each has their own house and their own life.
✓ Done
🎒
Inventory Bags
Click any villager's name to see their bag. Each person can carry one dragon egg. You can also make them an Explorer!
✓ Done
🥚
Finding Dragon Eggs!
🧭
The Explorer
Make a villager an Explorer and a glowing shape appears on the world map. Use WASD or arrow keys to move them around!
⚡ New!
🥚
10 Hidden Eggs
Dragon eggs are hiding all over the map — in forests, mountains, plains, beach, and even in the sea. Every new game puts them in different spots!
⚡ New!
❗
Egg Nearby!
When your explorer gets close to a hidden egg, a glowing gold "!" appears above them. Get even closer and you discover what's there!
⚡ New!
🚩
Pick Up or Flag
When you find an egg you can pick it up (it goes in your explorer's bag!) or leave a red flag to come back for it later.
⚡ New!
🐉
5 Dragon Types
Forest Drake, Stone Drake, Ember Drake, Sea Drake, and the super rare Gold Drake. You won't know which egg is which until you find it!
⚡ New!
💾
Saving Your Progress
⏱️
Auto-Save
Every 5 minutes the game saves itself automatically. It keeps your last 10 saves so you can never lose too much progress.
✓ Done
⌨️
Quick Save
Press F5 any time to save right now. A little "Game Saved" message fades in and then disappears — nice and clean.
✓ Done
